items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But that’s when I first heard of Glen Campbell. He was one of the Wrecking Crew.

ctx.x: How did you divide the work up, because usually you had multiple guitar players on a session?

Sometimes. Usually two. Sometimes one. Some sessions three. I worked in LA with Tommy Tedesco, the Wrecking Crew, all those guys. And they could all read. That’s when they say, “they could read flypaper.” Tedesco could read charts upside down. He could play charts upside — literally turn it over and play it backwards. He could read anything. But that’s when I first heard of Glen Campbell. He was one of the Wrecking Crew. He could not read but he had such great ears. If he heard it one time he could play it back.…
When you went to do a session invariably you’re going to be playing music that you might not like. How do you adjust your attitude towards that.
